changes: Move independent readability to the initial output contract and distinguish describing an event from pointing to the passage that mentions it. Remove the redundant later version of that rule.
Keep labels/credits/identifiers as interpretation evidence while excluding their mere presence/formatting as subjects; do not instruct the model to ignore those contextual cues.
Make preserving a number-label pairing retain its referent, while retaining the successful ban on an unstated unit/counted object.
Remove the synthetic example: it did not provide a reliable solution in the repeated diagnostics.
hypotheses: An upfront output criterion will reduce context-dependent event aliases and bare numeric fields.
Clarifying the role of contextual labels/credits will preserve domain context and help distinguish a reported source from a separate analysis section.

audit.interpretation: This is a candidate hypothesis, not a claim that instruction order or metadata filtering has been causally isolated. Functional requirements and validation gates are unchanged.

test_plan: First run the same D23/D24/D25 diagnostic three times with fresh isolated Sol-low calls. Do not submit to the full 28-note run or final validation unless the resulting evidence warrants it.
limits: Fifth of six new revisions. All final-validation notes remain unused.
